scripts.build: pnpm typecheck && vite build && uv run python -m humanoid_agent.presentation.publish_viewer
scripts.lint: biome check web/*.tsx web/*.ts web/*.css web/*.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json
scripts.format: biome check --write web/*.tsx web/*.ts web/*.css web/*.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json
scripts.check:python: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run ty check
scripts.test:python: uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests
scripts.verify: pnpm check:python && pnpm check && pnpm test:python && pnpm test && pnpm docs:check
scripts.test:assets: uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests/asset_integration
